scenes.caption: A nightly batch is too late for a streaming signal.
Kafka receives transactions. Spark parses the JSON and applies explainable fraud rules.
Event-time windows summarize merchants. Watermarks bound the state kept for late events.
Cassandra stores transaction verdicts and merchant metrics in separate tables.
Would you ship an answer that scores well overall, but fails a required grounding check?
My evaluator separates weighted rubric scores from hard thresholds.
Fourteen deterministic metrics run offline. Optional LLM judges score custom criteria.
Inspect per-case failures through the dashboard, REST API or command-line CI gate.
A fluent answer is not enough. Can you trace it back to a source?
Documents become sentence-aware chunks. Retrieval blends vector similarity with keyword overlap.
The default reader extracts from retrieved context and abstains when evidence is missing.
An evaluation harness checks retrieval and grounding on a sample corpus.
The problem: quality guidelines are often prose, while releases need repeatable decisions.
Each case carries an input, an output and the reference or context needed to judge it.
JSON and YAML rubrics define criteria, weights and optional hard thresholds.
Deterministic metrics check overlap, exact matches, numbers, structure and other constraints.
An optional model judge uses a vendor-neutral chat interface for custom criteria.
The engine produces per-case breakdowns, JSON reports and an interactive HTML dashboard.
Token overlap is not semantic truth. A passing benchmark does not prove broad reliability.
The repository shows the scoring code, tests and benchmark. Explore it from my portfolio.
Start with the question: how do we answer from a document collection without inventing missing information? Walkthrough of the offline default path, not a live customer deployment.
The application connects a FastAPI backend with a browser chat interface. Separate services and interfaces keep each stage inspectable.
Ingestion splits documents into sentence-aware chunks instead of arbitrary character slices. Chunk boundaries affect what evidence retrieval can recover.
The default feature-hashing embedder works without downloading a model. Reproducible offline development. configurable embeddings.
A cosine vector store finds candidates. Re-ranking blends similarity with keyword overlap. Retrieval quality determines which evidence reaches the reader.
The extractive reader answers from retrieved context and abstains when the context is insufficient. The default is extractive, not unrestricted generative completion.
Source citations connect the answer to its originating chunk. A citation is useful only if the passage supports the claim.
A router sends arithmetic questions to a restricted AST calculator and other questions to RAG. Tool routing is explicit and returned to the interface.
Server-Sent Events stream responses through the chat endpoint. Streaming changes delivery; it does not itself improve factual quality.
The evaluation harness checks retrieval hit-rate, reciprocal rank, faithfulness and answer relevance. Sample-corpus thresholds are gated in CI.
Configuration can swap in sentence-transformers, pgvector, Ollama, Gemini or OpenAI backends. Optional integrations require their own runtime setup and evaluation.
The limitation: sample-corpus checks do not establish reliability across arbitrary documents. Broader corpora, adversarial missing-evidence cases and abstention tests come next.
Explore the backend, tests and evaluation code. The best evidence is the implementation itself.
